purpose: Define a response-blind, taxonomically and geographically coherent Lepidoptera subset from the frozen 211-species phylogatR survivor panel before any subpanel genetic response is computed.

panel_reconstruction.allowed_fasta_surface: header lines beginning with > only; sequence lines are discarded without decoding or interpretation
panel_reconstruction.one_panel_per_species: maximum exact unique matched localities; then maximum aligned-header count; then lexical raw-gene identifier

interpretation: The rectangle is a deliberately conservative sampling-domain screen, not a replacement definition of the Palearctic biogeographic realm. The primary panel is described as Palearctic-core sampled Lepidoptera.
